steps.title: Babel's version of a generator
steps.text: transform-generator.js is what Babel produced for the `genn` generator in index.js: a `switch` on `_context.next`, where each `case` is a place the function can resume. The page ran it once and printed the values sent back in.
steps.textZh: transform-generator.js 是 Babel 为 index.js 里的 `genn` 生成器产出的代码：一个针对 `_context.next` 的 `switch`，每个 `case` 都是函数可以继续执行的位置。页面运行了一遍，打印出送回来的几个值。

steps.title: The first next()
steps.text: The first `next()` runs `case 0` up to `return 'saber'`, and sets `_context.next = 2`: the bookmark for the next call.
steps.textZh: 第一次 `next()` 从 `case 0` 运行到 `return 'saber'`，并设置 `_context.next = 2`：这就是下次调用时的书签。
steps.actionLabel: Call next() on a fresh generator
steps.actionLabelZh: 在一个新的生成器上调用 next()

steps.title: Send a value in
steps.text: The second call resumes at `case 2`. The value you pass, here `'hello'`, arrives as `_context.sent` and becomes `a`.
steps.textZh: 第二次调用从 `case 2` 继续。你传入的值（这里是 `'hello'`）作为 `_context.sent` 到达，并赋给 `a`。

action.run: const run = genn(); run.next(); console.log('next("hello"):', JSON.stringify(run.next('hello')))

steps.title: Run it to the end
steps.text: `_context.abrupt('return', …)` finishes the generator. After that, every `next()` reports `done: true`.
steps.textZh: `_context.abrupt('return', …)` 结束生成器。之后每次调用 `next()` 都会报告 `done: true`。

action.run: const run = genn(); run.next(); run.next('a'); run.next('b'); console.log('last next():', JSON.stringify(run.next('c'))); console.log('after the end:', JSON.stringify(run.next()))
